operations.name: Burt Lorton

expected.charges: Seditious conspiracy and conspiracy to obstruct military service — convicted at the mass IWW trial in Chicago (Espionage Act of 1917 / Sedition Act of 1918).
expected.sentence:
Ten years in prison and a $30,000 fine. Held in the Cook County Jail and the U.S. Penitentiary at Leavenworth (register no. 13132) from September 7, 1917 to December 24, 1923.

Verdict as recorded: Yes — convicted at the Chicago IWW mass trial; sentenced August 30, 1918.

operations.research_note: Contemporary Naujienos August 31, 1918 p4 explicitly describes K. M. Landis sentencing the Chicago IWW defendants the previous afternoon and lists Bert Lorton among concurrent ten-year defendants. Added missing judge only. Government compilation separately confirms August 30, 1918 ten-year sentence but gives $20,000 fine, conflicting with existing $30,000; retained populated sentence pending dedicated reconciliation. https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/SERIALSET-07987_00_00-063-0159-0000/pdf/SERIALSET-07987_00_00-063-0159-0000.pdf
